## Reading materials and tools

-   I'll soon have material in an online textbook for you

### *Additional resources*

-   [Bioinformatics Data Skills](https://vincebuffalo.com/book/). 2015. Vince Buffalo. O'Reilly.
-   See the [Resources](Resources.qmd) page for appendices, a glossary, cheat sheets, and more.

### *Tools*

-   You will be working on your own laptop computer
-   A Terminal application (see 'Software' Tab for installation)
-   Latest version of R ([install here](https://www.r-project.org))
-   Latest version of RStudio ([install here](https://www.rstudio.org))
-   A terminal that allows ssh connection to the UO computing cluster (Talapas)
-   Git installed and a GitHub account
-   LaTeX installed on your computer

## Course schedule
